description_en: Creates a web core protection rule

name: CreateDefenseRule

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of your WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看您当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection template for the protection rule to be created.
This parameter is required only when DefenseType is set to template.
The number of rules that can be created in a single protection template is limited. For more information, see Rule quantity limits. If the limit is reached, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461613.html operation to create a new protection template, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461422.html operation to modify an existing rule
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的防护规则的防护模板ID。
仅当 DefenseType 为 template 时，需要传入该参数。
同一防护模板内可创建的规则数量存在上限，具体限制请参见规则数量限制。当规则数量已达上限时，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461613.html接口创建新的防护模板。也可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461422.html接口修改已有的规则
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The WAF protection scenario to be created.

Valid values when the protection rule type DefenseType is set to template:

waf_group: basic protection.
waf_base: new version of web core protection.

antiscan: scan protection.

ip_blacklist: IP blacklist.

custom_acl: custom rules.

whitelist: whitelist.

region_block: area blocking.

custom_response: custom response of the old version.

cc: HTTP flood protection.

tamperproof: web tamper-proofing.

dlp: data leak prevention.

spike_throttle: peak traffic throttling.

bot_manager: bot management.


Valid values when the protection rule type DefenseType is set to resource:

account_identifier: account extraction.

custom_response: custom response of the new version.

waf_codec: decoding.

websdk: WebSDK integration.

Valid values when the protection rule type DefenseType is set to global:

regular_custom: custom regular expressions.

address_book: address book.

custom_response: custom response of the new version.
For globally configured custom responses, you can reference them under protected objects or rules. When custom response rules are referenced at different dimensions, the actual effective priority is: rule level > protected object level > default page
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的WAF防护场景。

当防护规则类型 DefenseType 为 template 时，取值：

waf_group：表示基础防护。
waf_base：表示新版Web核心防护。

antiscan：表示扫描防护。

ip_blacklist：表示IP黑名单。

custom_acl：表示自定义规则。

whitelist：表示白名单。

region_block：表示区域封禁。

custom_response：表示老版自定义响应。

cc：表示CC防护。

tamperproof：表示网页防篡改。

dlp：表示信息泄露防护。

spike_throttle：表示洪峰限流。

bot_manager: 表示BOT管理。


当防护规则类型 DefenseType 为 resource 时，取值：

account_identifier：表示账号提取。

custom_response：表示新版自定义响应。

waf_codec：表示解码。

websdk：表示WebSDK集成。

当防护规则类型 DefenseType 为 global 时，取值：

regular_custom：表示自定义正则。

address_book：表示地址簿。

custom_response：表示新版自定义响应。
全局配置的自定义响应，用户可在防护对象或者规则下引用，当用户在不同维度引用配置了自定义响应规则时，真实生效逻辑为：规则级别 > 防护对象级别 > 默认页面
parameters.name: defense_scene

parameters.help_en:
The rule configuration content, which is converted into a string in JSON format constructed by a series of parameters.
The specific parameters involved vary depending on the specified protection rule type (DefenseScene). For more information, see Protection rule parameter description
parameters.help_zh:
规则配置内容，以一系列参数构造的JSON格式转化成字符串。
根据所指定的防护规则类型（DefenseScene）不同，具体涉及的参数有所不同。详细信息，请参见防护规则参数描述
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run mode. If this parameter is not specified, a normal request is initiated. Valid values:
true: initiates a dry run request. The system only checks whether the request meets the execution conditions and does not perform the operations specified in the request. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the dry run succeeds, the error code Defense.Control.DryRunOperation is returned.
false: initiates a normal request. The system performs the operations specified in the request after the check succeeds
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启 DryRun 预检模式。如果不输入该参数，表示发起正常请求。取值：
true：表示发起预检请求，仅检查请求是否满足执行条件，不执行请求指定的操作。预检不通过时返回相应错误码；预检通过时返回错误码Defense.Control.DryRunOperation。
false：表示发起正常请求；检查通过后执行请求指定的操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the protection rule
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The protected object corresponding to the created rule.
This parameter is required only when DefenseType is set to resource
parameters.help_zh:
创建规则对应的防护对象。
仅当 DefenseType 为 resource 时，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The type of the protected target. This parameter applies to rules where DefenseType is set to resource. Valid values:

single (default): a single protected object.
group: a protection group
parameters.help_zh:
防护目标类型。适用于DefenseType 为 resource 的规则。取值：

single（默认）：表示单个防护对象。
group：表示防护组
parameters.name: resource_type

RuleIds.description_en: The IDs of the created protection rules. Multiple protection rule IDs are separated by commas (,)
RuleIds.description_zh: 创建的防护规则ID，多个防护规则ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
